As Csx Corp. (CSX) Stock Rose, Shareholder Bennicas & Associates Has Trimmed Stake by $352,000; Selway Asset Management Has Increased Apple (AAPL) Position by $352,704 as Share Value Rose
May 31, 2018 - By Jonathan Benavides
Selway Asset Management increased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 4.36% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Selway Asset Management bought 2,112 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 50,594 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.49 million, up from 48,482 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Selway Asset Management who had been investing in Apple Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $920.11 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.16% or $0.3 during the last trading session, reaching $187.2. About 17.53M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Bennicas & Associates Inc decreased its stake in Csx Corp. (CSX) by 11.19% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bennicas & Associates Inc sold 6,400 shares as the company’s stock rose 15.07% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 50,800 shares of the railroads company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.83 million, down from 57,200 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bennicas & Associates Inc who had been investing in Csx Corp. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $56.90 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.33% or $0.87 during the last trading session, reaching $64.77. About 3.22M shares traded. CSX Corporation (NYSE:CSX) has risen 20.25% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.68% the S&P500.
Analysts await CSX Corporation (NASDAQ:CSX) to report earnings on July, 17. They expect $0.84 earnings per share, up 31.25% or $0.20 from last year’s $0.64 per share. CSX’s profit will be $737.96M for 19.28 P/E if the $0.84 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.78 actual earnings per share reported by CSX Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 7.69% EPS growth.
